headline: EU Right-Wing Alliance Approves Two-Year Delay on Methane Rules
summary: A right-wing alliance in the European Union rubber-stamped a two-year postponement of EU methane rules, marking a regulatory delay welcomed by energy firms.
why: EU environmental regulations impose compliance and capital expenditure requirements on oil and gas operators.

impacts.name: European oil and gas sector
impacts.why: Postponing strict environmental compliance standards defers capital expenditures for energy producers.
